title: Lefroy Bay area, CTX DTM 20 m (bounded crop)

dtm.crs: Equirectangular (standard parallel 0°, central meridian 0°), Mars 2000 sphere R = 3,396,190 m; planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
dtm.verticalDatum: Heights in metres relative to the Mars areoid (product label: MOLAtopography_DeltaGeoid)

crop.rationale: Square 3.2 km crop centred on the verified Margin sample sites (Pelican Point, Lefroy Bay, Comet Geyser) and the scenario-defined targets A–C, which all lie inside it.

heights.encoding: float32 little-endian, row-major from north to south, west to east; each value is the DTM post at its post centre; copied unchanged

imagery.resampling: bilinear from the z13 tile mosaic onto the crop's exact bounds; greyscale

alignment.method: Topographic shading: normalised cross-correlation between the high-passed orthoimage brightness and the DTM slope along a fitted illumination azimuth, on the 20 m grid, for shifts of ±4 posts. The build fails if the peak is more than 2 posts from zero.
alignment.interpretation: Rules out a gross offset (2 posts, 40 m, or more) between imagery and elevations. The correlation is modest because albedo also varies, so sub-post (< 20 m) registration is not demonstrated.

caveats: CTX DTM posts are 20 m apart; the effective resolution is coarser (a few posts). Features smaller than about 60–100 m are not resolved, and nothing here shows rocks or traversability.
Elevations are relative to the areoid, not to the surface of a reference ellipsoid.
The scenario-defined targets are simulated positions; their elevations are read from the DTM only to place them on the surface.
